message:
Hi Joe -- Thank you very much for this great tool! It is helping all of us a lot. Thank you very much!
Question: Is there a way to save two text projects in the form of/for this app? E.g., a psalm passage and a job passage? I know that you built in an auto-save feature, which is super-helpful. But is there a way to save two text projects, or even to run two text projects simultaneously?
Thanks very much -- Susan
